title: FileTransfer：源/目标身份认证、大小与 SHA 校验、Hub staged blob 原子提升、Hub 重启后无半成品

cases.title: SYS-59 源 Agent 身份认证、源节点只能上传
cases.canonical_before: NOT_RUN (repair build not executed; legacy baseline excluded per remaining_dimensions)

covered_dimensions.layer: real Agent HTTP auth + real Transfer dispatch (owned child Agent, exact repair binary)
description: A real single-target transfer created on the Hub was uploaded by the source child Agent using its own real agent credential (X-NodeSteer-Agent-ID/Token) and completed to SUCCESS; the Hub recorded exactly the source size/sha256.
The source node could NOT download its own transfer: an authenticated GET /agent/transfers/<id>/download as the source returned 403 "agent is not a transfer target".
A non-source Agent could NOT upload: authenticated POST upload as the target node returned 403 "agent is not the transfer source".

Wrong/absent credentials were rejected: bogus token 401 "invalid agent credential", unknown agent-id 401, no headers 401 "agent authentication required", and a management bearer token on the Agent channel 401.
All negatives left the transfer row byte-identical (no side effect).

cases.title: SYS-60 目标 Agent 身份认证、目标只能下载自己的目标
cases.canonical_before: NOT_RUN (repair build not executed; legacy baseline excluded per remaining_dimensions)

covered_dimensions.layer: real target Agent download auth + atomic replace (owned child Agent)
description: The target child Agent authenticated with its own credential and downloaded the delivery it was dispatched, producing the exact source size/sha256/mode on disk.
The target could NOT upload (it is not the source) -> 403 "agent is not the transfer source".
A node that is not a target of a transfer cannot download it -> 403 "agent is not a transfer target" (source-download negative).
Delivery is per-target: the transfer carries exactly one target row and the destination is replaced atomically (no temp left).

cases.title: SYS-61 大小校验、SHA256 校验、Hub staged blob 原子提升
cases.canonical_before: NOT_RUN (repair build not executed; legacy baseline excluded per remaining_dimensions)

covered_dimensions.layer: real upload endpoint validation / Hub staging blob / target SHA verification
description: Size validation on the real Agent upload endpoint: non-numeric size 400, negative size 400, declared size vs Content-Length mismatch 400 "content length mismatch"; the correct upload returned 200 and the Hub recorded the exact payload sha256.

Hub staged-blob atomic promotion: while the transfer was staged and undelivered the Hub held <id>.blob (sha256 == source) and no <id>.part, i.e. the .part -> .blob rename happened atomically; after success both were cleaned.

SHA256 validation on the target: with the staged blob deliberately corrupted before delivery the target Agent's verifying reader rejected the payload, the target reported FAILED and no half/corrupt file was installed.
Restoring the blob and retrying the failed target produced SUCCESS with the exact source sha256/size.

cases.title: SYS-66 Hub 重启、Agent 重连、目标离线后状态和文件不产生半成品
cases.canonical_before: NOT_RUN (repair build not executed; legacy baseline excluded per remaining_dimensions)

covered_dimensions.layer: repair-Hub unit restart / sqlite persistence / owned child reconnect / offline target
description: The source uploaded and the Hub staged the blob while the target was offline; the transfer row (id/sha256/size) survived the ONE authorised repair-Hub restart unchanged.
While the target stayed offline no destination file and no temp file existed on the target node, both before and after the restart (no half product).

The source Agent reconnected by itself after the restart; when the target was brought back it reconnected, ResumeNode dispatched the delivery exactly once, and the target received the complete file with the exact source sha256/size/mode and no leftover temp.
After a settle window the transfer was terminal SUCCESS with a single target row: a Hub restart produced no duplicate delivery or duplicated target row.

remaining_or_limitations: The observed Hub outage is short (unit stop/start, ~1-3 s); a long outage beyond the Agent heartbeat timeout was not exercised.

The authority state was read from the Hub SQLite read-only copy and the REST API; the target verification failure was produced by corrupting the fixture's own staged blob (harness fault injection on the owned transfer only).

harness_seams.authority: management and agent data-plane writes only to repair http://192.168.100.209:18080
harness_seams.hub_restart: only nodesteer-hub-repair-20260930-101945.service was stopped/started once; nodesteer-hub.service (:8080) and all Agent units untouched
harness_seams.owned_children: source on native-1 and target on native-2, exact repair Agent binary d55dc5cd..., each behind its own harness frame proxy on the operator host
harness_seams.credential_source: each child's own store (identity.credential), never a protected Agent config

attempts: evidence/attempt01-harness-bug/ : the first attempt aborted with a harness AttributeError (Run.wait_pred) before the Hub restart. No Hub restart and no half product; recorded and re-run.

evidence/attempt02-blob-ownership-harness-bug/ : the second attempt aborted in phase5 because the harness restored the corrupted staged blob with copy+os.replace, which handed the blob to uid 0; the Hub service (a different uid) then could not open it and the retry target reported "download status 404". This 404 was a HARNESS fault (artifact ownership), NOT a product defect: the SHA256 negative itself behaved correctly (target FAILED with "sha256 mismatch", no half file). The restore was changed to an in-place rewrite that preserves owner/mode and the batch was re-run completely.
post_run_addendum.note: across all attempts only nodesteer-hub-repair-20260930-101945.service was ever stopped/started; the primary :8080 Hub (MainPID 1251) and every Agent unit kept their MainPID the whole time. No credential is persisted in any evidence file.
